header: End-of-transfer step for the sequencer group: if bit 4 of 0xBD1A is set (the sequencer blocks were received), validates the block-0 panel records at 0xF480, inside the received current-song record (MidiSysEx_ProcessBlock_Helper13 -> PanelTlv_ValidateBlock0), resolves the part companions, restores the song selection 0xFFE3/0xFFEC saved in 0xF247/0xF248 (MidiSysEx_ProcessBlock_Helper12), sets bit 1 of 0xBD18 and clears bit 4. Basis: callers + body -- MidiSysEx_ProcessBlock (command 4, transfer done) calls it after MidiSysEx_FinishPanelXfer and MidiSysEx_FinishSoundRamXfer; bit 4 is set only by SeqChan_WriteField_Data_D, the end step (state 14) of the sequencer blocks 11-14 (current song 0xF180, song slots, event memory).

why_refused: Mechanics are clear, meaning is not. Its only caller SwbtB2_CodeA8_Listener (one of the SwbtB2_CodeA8_Listeners callbacks for panel event 0xA8) runs it when the event's arg (SWBTWR_PAYLOAD_1) is 12, in display mode 0 with bit 3 of 0x0D53 set. The body: when PAYLOAD_2 & PAYLOAD_3 & 3 is 0 it toggles bits 0/1 of a copy of PAYLOAD_2 (RH3 carry tricks), masks it with PAYLOAD_3, stores it to 0x0DC0 and runs SysEx_BytecodeDispatcher; then, when PAYLOAD_2 bits 0-1 are set, it may reset the display caches, run Scoop_SpecialMode_ParamCheckBound and SerialPort_ModeHandler_0_Sub and sends SysEx 118 (MIDI_SendSysExFromW); finally it indexes PerfMode_Handler_EvtB_Data with PAYLOAD_2/3 bits 3-4 to pick a ScoopDisp_DispatchTable_Extended handler (VoiceCtrl_CheckAndReset or nothing) and clears bit 3 of 0x0D54 and bits 1-2 of 0x10F9 when PAYLOAD_2 & 63 = 0. Event 0xA8 with arg 11 or 12 is not in the documented panel-button action table (technics-docs control-panel-protocol.md lists args 2-6, 9, 0x12, 0x14, 0x41), so which button or source posts it -- and so what the 2-bit fields mean -- is not established.

why_refused: Mechanics are partly clear, meaning is not. It counts the 0x81 bytes up to 0x83 in a rhythm-ROM pattern stream (RhythmROM_CountEntries, stream chosen by header byte +0x3D1; count to 0x35B3); for sections (0x34EF) = 0-3 it compares the count with AccFill_AdvanceAndCheck_Code[time-signature byte +0x0C] and returns A = 7 (or 3 with bit 1 of 0x35B0 set on a match); for sections 4-7 it recounts at +0x138/+0x13C/+0x538/+0x53C, divides and may send SysEx command 8; sections 8-15 return 0. The caller RhythmROM_PatternDisp_ReadByte has no header and its name is a placeholder; A is stored as byte +0x0D of the pattern record at (0x3560), whose meaning is not documented, and 0x81/0x83 in the rhythm-ROM stream are not identified (bar markers would be a guess).
